first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence links shorter onboarding and simpler signup to stronger early adoption. A standard experiment should target the immediate funnel deterioration while measuring qualified activation and downstream revenue, guarding against gains that are only superficial. Pricing remains a fallback, but may acquire lower-quality accounts and create longer-term margin risk.

final.rationale: Run a standard, guarded simplification of onboarding this week. The verified record shows shorter onboarding increased completion, reduced time-to-value, and improved 30-day retention, directly addressing both current declines. Measure qualified activation, time-to-value, 30-day retention, and revenue quality—not completion alone—to ensure the lift is sustainable. Keep pricing unchanged in this experiment; promotional pricing can be evaluated later if the SMB competitive threat persists.
